inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that infant daily reports were not being shared with parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two of the four children's immunizations were not updated at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: Based on the interviews conducted by the staff and parent it was determined a child was dropped off at the wrong elementary school by a daycare driver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Three out of five children's files reviewed did not have current immunization records available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The posted Children's Products Annual Certification was expired. This was corrected at inspection when the Director completed a current form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: There were five ceiling tiles missing in the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: Two caregivers in the toddler rooms did not know the names of the children or ages they were responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety restraint devices for child used when vehicle is on and during all time vehicle in motion: The vehicles used to transport children do not have proper restraints for the age group transporting. Children ages 3 years to 7 years were not secured in a booster seats.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety restraint devices for child used when vehicle is on and during all time vehicle in motion (26 TAC §746.5607(e))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: The toddler caregiver was seen on her cell phone during nap time.     Note, corrected at inspection after talking to the caregiver and director about no personal cell phone usage  while in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The available health inspection posted was last conducted on 12.1.22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of the eight children files didn't have a current immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Four of the eight staff files were missing First aid and CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies: A written procedure on how to handle transportation emergencies was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies (26 TAC §746.5619)

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: One of the two staff transporting didn't have training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Six out of the eight children files were missing special care information.     One of the eight children files were missing food allergy information.    One of the eight children files were missing emergency authorization care information.    One of the eight children files were missing emergency contact address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Five of the eight staff files were missing education qualifications.    Three of the eight staff files were missing affidavits.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated: A written, signed and dated medication authorization was not available for review for one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated (26 TAC §746.3803(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: The school age teacher was unaware of the name of the youngest and oldest of the group.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when a name to face was conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The toddler teacher was observed with six children SAG of 12-17 months which made the teacher over by one child.     NOTE: This was corrected when the youngest child was moved to the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The health inspection was last conducted on 5.12.22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection was last conducted on 5.16.22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Emergency medical information for 7 children were not available for review.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of the eight children did not have shot records available for review.    In addition to one of the eight children missing medical authorization information.    NOTE: One of the two shot records was provided.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: Diaper changing supplies in the toddler and two infant classrooms were observed accessible in the children cubbies.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: Documentation for the carbon monoxide, extinguisher and smoke detectors were not documented for January, February and March.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: On the changing table of the toddler classroom a Lysol spray can was observed accessible to the children. In addition to diaper cream on the changing table in the infant classroom.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when it was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Infestation: Based on the information gathered, and interviews conducted during this investigation parents were not notified in writing within 48 hours about the outbreak of lice.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Infestation (26 TAC §746.307(e))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information gathered, and interviews conducted the operation staff did not demonstrate good judgment by not assisting in the basic care with toileting for a child who was partially toilet trained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Three out of eight employee records reviewed were missing the required affidavit for employment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Four out of eight children's records reviewed were missing required information including emergency contact information and healthcare provider statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the investigation a caregiver in direct care of children had not received required background check eligibility notifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Based on the information received, parents were not notified of less serious injuries such as scratches during pick up time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Operation Open to Parents At All Times: Based on the information received parents are not allowed to enter the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: In the school age classroom a Tv was not anchored.     This was corrected at inspection when director removed TV from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Annual first inspection had not been updated since 10/19/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
